title: Providing internal elevator at Ponnani Lighthouse
summary: E-tender (two-cover) for providing an internal elevator at Ponnani Lighthouse, Malappuram District, Kerala (Kochi Directorate); bid deadlines extended by Corrigendum II to 29.10.2024.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

scope.item: Providing internal elevator at Ponnani Lighthouse

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR from any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; originals (or MSME/UDYAM/NSIC certificate) with technical documents by registered/speed post or in person by the deadline. Tender fee Nil.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: (A) Lift manufacturing agency with valid licence/registration from State CEIG or other State/Central licensing authority, with experience in fabrication and erection of structural steel tower for lift and lift installation; OR contractor registered in appropriate category/class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL etc. in Joint Venture Consortium with lift manufacturing agency
(B) Similar works in last 7 years: three each >= 40%, two each >= 50%, or one >= 80% of estimated cost; completed works with completion certificate only

Similar work: supply, installation, testing and commissioning of elevator; for JV, first party civil works (RCC tower, steel structures, multi-storeyed building, bridge, water tank) and second party lift manufacturer experience; second party to submit CEIG manufacturing licence
(D) CA-certified annual turnover of last three years

corrigenda.change: Corrigendum II: last date for bid submission extended to 29.10.2024 15:00; original EMD/technical documents by 28.10.2024 15:00; technical bid opening 30.10.2024 15:00

notes: Section I NIT only; no lift specification or BOQ. Original schedule: download/submission 16.09.2024 10:00 to 15.10.2024 15:00; bid queries by 01.10.2024 15:00; EMD original by 14.10.2024 15:00; technical bid opening 16.10.2024 15:00. Corrigendum I (not among listing documents) is implied by the numbering. Listing shows end 2024-10-29 but opening 2024-10-16 (original opening date).
